participant_contract.rule: The comparison layer must use the edition adapter's participant entity and must not infer person/team from labels.
participant_contract.team_membership_rule: Team membership does not imply verified leg assignment.

no_fabrication: Do not impute missing official checkpoint observations for gap, placement, segment or ranking analytics.
Do not synthesize a finish for DNF or incomplete results.
Do not present reconstructed route position as measured participant GPS.
evidence_rules.same_race_edition_segment_rule: An official adjacent segment may be compared when both selected results have exact segment evidence.
evidence_rules.cross_edition_segment_rule: A cross-edition segment may be compared only when the event course/comparison contract explicitly permits that segment and both selected results have exact segment evidence.
evidence_rules.checkpoint_gap_rule: Checkpoint gaps require a common analytically comparable checkpoint and exact published passages for both selected results.
evidence_rules.whole_course_rule: Finish ranking/gap across different RaceEditions requires explicit whole-course comparability.
evidence_rules.geometry_rule: Shared animated geometry requires a route/course contract that permits the two selected results to share display geometry.

finish_comparison.description: Compare finish status/time/gap where finish evidence and whole-course comparability permit.

checkpoint_gap.description: Signed gap journey from common exact official checkpoint observations.

placement_journey.description: Official placement journey from source-supported checkpoint placements.

segment_comparison.description: Clickable segment duel using exact adjacent observations and event comparability rules.

edition_field_normalization.description: Participant segment performance relative to the stable field reference for that participant's own RaceEdition.

shared_course_context.description: Shared map/elevation context for a verified/common course geometry.

animated_two_result_comparison.description: Two reconstructed participant positions on a shared race clock inside Direct Comparison.

elevation_seek.description: Seek the shared race clock from the elevation profile.

shareable_comparison_state.description: Share the two selected results and supported comparison state via URL.

cross_edition_comparison.description: Compare results from different RaceEditions while independently gating finish/checkpoint/segment/geometry dimensions.

sparse_comparison_fallback.description: Purpose-built simplified comparison when only sparse official timing observations exist.

team_entity.description: Direct Comparison and Map Duel can compare teams without coercing them into person semantics.

audio.description: Race-family soundtrack during replay when event media exists.

interaction_rules: Primary actions must work by click/tap; hover is supplementary.
Selecting a checkpoint/segment should synchronize other supported comparison views.
Observed values and reconstructed motion must be visually/methodologically distinguishable.
Unavailable capabilities must be omitted or replaced by an explicit evidence-aware fallback, never fake data.

a_b_semantics.signed_checkpoint_gap: B elapsed - A elapsed; positive means A ahead.
a_b_semantics.signed_segment_delta: B segment - A segment; positive means A won time.
a_b_semantics.color_rule: A/B colors are comparison-role colors, not sex colors; event themes may map tokens but must preserve distinction and contrast.

chart_rules.gap_chart: Show signed y-axis scale, zero/equal reference, distance/checkpoint context and explanatory legend.
chart_rules.field_chart: Show percent y-axis scale and explicit 0% field-median reference.
chart_rules.placement_chart: Show official placement only; missing placement breaks the series.

sparse_mode.intent: Preserve usefulness when the edition has too few real timing anchors for the full comparison surface.
sparse_mode.activation: Adapter/capability driven; typically when the normal checkpoint/segment journey cannot be supported by at least two meaningful common intermediate observations.
required_behavior: Show the real observed timing anchors in a simplified START -> observed checkpoint(s) -> FINISH journey.
Do not invent extra segments or interpolate analytical observations.
Allow shared map/replay independently if route and timing-anchor evidence supports it.

gotaleden: member rows do not create leg assignments
osterlen_spring_trail: short-course editions without splits must not receive synthetic segment analytics
satila: physical pace must remain gated where timing-distance metadata is not trustworthy
existing map/elevation interaction should be preserved while analytical panels converge
ultravasan: cross-edition comparison is independently gated by whole-course, checkpoint, segment and geometry contracts
verified identity history remains separate from comparison evidence

non_goals: Do not require identical DOM/CSS or a shared physical JavaScript runtime.
Do not erase event-specific participant, course, timing or evidence semantics.
Do not force every capability to be present for every RaceEdition.
Do not downgrade existing stronger event-specific functionality solely for visual uniformity.
